quizzes.question_text: This equation shows how the total number of pieces Keith knows how to sing depends on the number of weeks he takes voice lessons. $$\\[1em]$$ $p = w + 3$ $$\\[1em]$$ The variable $w$ represents the number of weeks he has taken voice lessons, and the variable $p$ represents the total number of pieces he has learned. How many weeks of lessons will Keith need before he will be able to sing a total of 12 pieces?
solution: Keith has learned 12 pieces. Substitute $p = 12$.
Substitute into the equation: $p = w + 3$ becomes $12 = w + 3$.
Subtract 3 to get $9 = w$.
Keith will need 9 weeks of lessons before he will be able to sing a total of 12 pieces.

quizzes.question_text: This equation shows how the time required to ring up a customer is related to the number of items being purchased. $$\\[1em]$$ $t = p + 17$ $$\\[1em]$$ The variable $p$ represents the number of items being purchased, and the variable $t$ represents the time required to ring up the customer. If it takes 20 seconds to ring up a customer, how many items are being purchased?
solution: It takes 20 seconds to ring up a customer. Substitute $t = 20$.
Substitute into the equation: $t = p + 17$ becomes $20 = p + 17$.
Subtract 17 to get $3 = p$.
If it takes 20 seconds to ring up a customer, 3 items are being purchased.

quizzes.question_text: This equation shows how the amount of dough Elena has prepared is related to the number of hours she has spent working at the bakery. $$\\[1em]$$ $d = h + 11$ $$\\[1em]$$ The variable $h$ represents the number of hours worked, and the variable $d$ represents the amount of dough prepared.
